name: Schema-Typed Five-Persona Design Council
description: Blueprint 16 of 96 (design card BP-CNC-01, 09-WORKFLOW-BLUEPRINT-LIBRARY.md:871). MECHANISM: five FIXED personas review one committed design artifact in parallel, each blind to the others, and each must return a verdict drawn from an ENUMERATED set - free text is a schema failure, not a soft pass. A null-tolerant barrier aggregates; a persona that fails schema validation is retried ONCE with the vocabulary restated inline and then recorded as a null lens (measured: our own schemas reject our own agents 22.7% of the time). SHADOW posture: the aggregate gate is non-blocking with on_fail=record-and-continue, so this council can never wedge the owner.

design_doc_path.description: The committed design document under review. A council over a verbal idea produces five opinions and no evidence, so a real artifact is required.

definition_of_done.description: What the design must achieve; personas score against this, not against taste

prior_decisions.description: Binding prior decisions the design may not silently re-open

personas.description: Fixed persona set. The 6th is the optional cross-vendor arm.

schema_retry_once.description: Retry a schema-invalid verdict once with the enumerated vocabulary restated inline before recording a null lens

pm.description: Product persona - judges whether the design serves the stated definition of done and nothing else

architect.description: Architecture persona - judges coupling, failure domains and whether the design introduces a second runtime

designer.description: Design persona - judges the surface the owner actually touches, including error and empty states

security.description: Security persona - REASONS about the design; it has no elevated access and does not scan (pair with the scanner workflow for that)

cto.description: CTO persona - judges whether this is worth building now against everything else competing for the same attention

codex-cross-vendor.description: Optional 6th persona on a different vendor - five same-vendor personas share blind spots

aggregator.description: Assembles the verdict table with a null-tolerant barrier and never converts a null lens into an approval

routes.reason: the 6th persona exists precisely to not share the other five blind spots

stages.title: S0 LOAD the design and the binding prior decisions

work_unit.title: Load the design document and the binding prior-decision set
work_unit.question_or_target: Confirm the design artifact exists and is non-empty, and assemble the binding prior decisions the design may not silently re-open.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: cheap assembly, but it must fail closed when the artifact is absent

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the brief records the design document byte length and content hash, so a persona verdict can be tied to the exact revision it reviewed
tests_required: an absent design_doc_path must FAIL this unit, never proceed to a five-persona fan-out over nothing
both-states control: point at a missing path and confirm FAILED, point at a real path and confirm SUCCESS
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: none - this is a mechanical load; the personas are the review
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:WCNC-0101 emitted when brief.json exists, parses, and records the design hash and byte length; otherwise FAILED:WCNC-0101 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: no retry on a missing artifact - that is an owner input error, not a transient failure

stages.title: S1 FAN-OUT the fixed personas in parallel, each blind, each returning a typed verdict

body.title: One persona returns one schema-valid verdict

work_unit.title: Return one persona verdict from the enumerated vocabulary with anchored blocking findings
work_unit.question_or_target: As the assigned persona only, return verdict APPROVE, APPROVE_WITH_CONDITIONS or REJECT, with every blocking finding citing the design document by section.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: one persona per item; the role is overridden per item by the persona key

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every blocking finding cites a section of the design document; a finding with no anchor is not a finding and is rejected by the enumeration gate
tests_required: a free-text verdict such as 'looks good to me' is a SCHEMA FAILURE, not a soft pass
seeded-hole benchmark: a design with a deliberate auth hole must produce a BLOCKING finding from the security persona
a clean design must produce APPROVE, not manufactured findings
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: no cross-review during the fan-out - blindness is the mechanism; the optional cross-vendor persona is a sibling, not a reviewer
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:WCNC-0102 emitted per persona when the verdict artifact exists, parses against council-audit, and the verdict is one of the three enumerated values; a schema-invalid verdict retried once then emits FAILED:WCNC-0102 null-lens
work_unit.retry_policy: exactly one retry with the enumerated vocabulary restated inline, then record a null lens - measured: our own schemas reject our own agents 22.7% of the time

stages.title: S1b A free-text verdict is a schema failure - assert the vocabulary before aggregating
S2 AGGREGATE with a null-tolerant barrier - a null lens is never an approval

work_unit.title: Aggregate the persona verdicts into one table, counting null lenses explicitly
work_unit.question_or_target: Build the verdict table: one row per persona, the aggregate, and an explicit count of null lenses. A null lens is reported as NOT-CHECKED, never folded into the approval count.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: aggregation is mechanical but the null-lens accounting is where a silent pass would hide

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the table states personas_requested, verdicts_returned, null_lenses and the derived unaccounted_personas, and unaccounted_personas must be 0; every blocking finding is carried forward verbatim with its anchor
tests_required: unaccounted_personas (personas_requested minus verdicts_returned minus null_lenses) must be 0 - the arithmetic is computed by the runner because the DSL expression grammar has no arithmetic operators
both-states control: drop one verdict file and confirm the reconciliation check FAILS, restore it and confirm it PASSES
a null lens must never increment the approval count
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one independent reader confirms the three counts reconcile and that no null lens was read as an approval
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:WCNC-0103 emitted when verdict-table.json exists, parses, and unaccounted_personas == 0; otherwise FAILED:WCNC-0103 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: emit the partial table with the reconciliation gap stated rather than a table that silently balances

stages.title: S3 EMIT - SHADOW posture: record the verdict, never block the owner

impact.blast_radius: read-only on the repo plus writes under command-center/design-council/bp-cnc-01/**; SHADOW posture means it cannot block a merge or a completion

x_extensions.distinct_mechanism: fixed-persona parallel fan-out with an ENUMERATED categorical verdict vocabulary, a retry-once-then-null-lens rule, explicit null-lens accounting that must reconcile, and a NON-BLOCKING shadow aggregate gate
x_extensions.not_a_duplicate_because: BP-CNC-06 scores on a weighted rubric with a critical-error override and returns a number; this returns categorical persona verdicts and no score. BP-CNC-04 reviews the CROSS-LANE premise structure of many outputs; this reviews ONE artifact. It is also the only blueprint in this range whose terminal gate is deliberately non-blocking.
contraindications: code review - that is a different blueprint with a different evidence standard
a plan - the plan gate uses adversarial reviewers, not personas
no artifact exists - a council over a verbal idea produces five opinions and no evidence
x_extensions.shadow_posture_note: shadow-aggregate has blocking=false and on_fail=record-and-continue on purpose. The enumeration gate IS blocking, because a free-text verdict makes the fan-in unreadable - that is a contract failure, not a design opinion. The distinction is deliberate: SHADOW applies to the design VERDICT, never to the schema contract.

worked_examples.name: seeded-hole benchmark - a design with a deliberate auth hole

params.definition_of_done: every catalogued unit can emit a receipt that validates against a resolvable schema, with exactly one control plane

worked_examples.walkthrough: The design proposes generating shims from an unauthenticated remote index. S0 records the design hash. S1 fans out five personas blind. security returns REJECT with a blocking finding anchored at the design section that fetches the index over the network, citing the fetched-content-is-data rule. architect returns APPROVE_WITH_CONDITIONS (one control plane, but the generator must be in-repo). pm, designer and cto return APPROVE. S1b passes: five enumerated verdicts, one anchored blocking finding, zero free text. S2 reconciles 5 requested = 5 returned + 0 null. S3 RECORDS blocking_findings == 1 and does NOT block - the owner sees a REJECT from security and decides.

worked_examples.name: negative control - a persona returns free text and one dies

params.definition_of_done: every catalogued unit can emit a schema-valid receipt

worked_examples.walkthrough: designer returns 'this looks fine to me' - not an enumerated value. The per-item retry fires once with the three legal values restated inline; the second attempt is severed, so designer is recorded as a null lens. The barrier quorum of 0.6 is met (4 of 5), so aggregation proceeds DEGRADED. S2 reports personas_requested=5, verdicts_returned=4, null_lenses=1 and the three numbers reconcile. The null lens is reported NOT-CHECKED and does NOT increment the approval count - which is the failure this accounting exists to prevent.

benchmark_cases: a design with a deliberate auth hole - the Security persona must raise it as blocking
a clean design - expect 5 APPROVE, not manufactured findings
x_extensions.unverified: UNVERIFIED whether 5 personas beat 3; settling experiment = ablate to 3 on ten designs and compare blocking-finding recall against the union of both arms. Confidence that the source workflow runs today: almost-certain (90-99%).
x_extensions.topology_note: The design card's topology is `5 fresh reviewers in parallel, each blind to the others -> 1 aggregator`. That is a FAN-OUT, not a deliberation, so this blueprint deliberately carries NO council stage - the c-s11-design-gate-5 preset is referenced as the seat contract rather than executed as a deliberating council. BP-CNC-02/04/05 are where deliberation actually happens.
